title: Portland Pivot Kick Study on Medial Meniscus Tears and Partial Meniscectomy
author: Samuel Moulton
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7d2hi8e
materials: The study timeline is as follows:

steps.title: Conduct Preoperative Visit
steps.instruction: Perform the initial patient evaluation and baseline data collection.

substeps.instruction: Evaluate the patient via physical examination, including the Portland Pivot Kick (PPK) maneuver.
Offer arthroscopic partial meniscectomy as a surgical option.
Administer the WOMAC and KOOS questionnaires for the patient to complete.

steps.title: Implement Postoperative Home Exercises
steps.instruction: Ensure the patient performs the designated home exercises during the postoperative period.

steps.title: Perform 6-Week Postoperative Follow-up
steps.instruction: Reevaluate the patient and collect outcome data at 6 weeks post-surgery.

substeps.instruction: Perform physical examination, including the PPK maneuver.
Administer the WOMAC and KOOS questionnaires.

steps.title: Perform 6-Month Postoperative Follow-up
steps.instruction: Reevaluate the patient and collect outcome data at 6 months post-surgery.

substeps.instruction: Perform physical examination, including the PPK maneuver.
Administer the WOMAC and KOOS questionnaires.

steps.title: Perform 1-Year Postoperative Follow-up
steps.instruction: Reevaluate the patient and collect outcome data at 1 year post-surgery.

substeps.instruction: Perform physical examination, including the PPK maneuver.
Administer the WOMAC and KOOS questionnaires.
